name: Plan a mission timeline
description: Build an end-to-end mission timeline with tasks assigned to assets and crews.

name: Generate candidate routes
description: Produce ranked route options between waypoints given terrain and threat overlays.

name: Evaluate plan feasibility
description: Check a draft plan against asset availability and crew duty limits before approval.

name: Rehearse a mission virtually
description: Step through a planned mission in simulation to spot conflicts before execution.

name: Replan during execution
description: Modify an in-progress mission when conditions change and push updates to the field.

name: Compare alternative plans
description: View two candidate plans side by side with cost and risk deltas.

name: Approve a mission plan
description: Route a completed plan through the required approval chain with digital signoff.

name: Archive completed missions
description: Preserve executed missions with their as-flown data for later analysis.

name: Import external tasking
description: Ingest tasking orders from partner systems into the planning workspace.

name: Deconflict shared airspace
description: Detect and resolve time and space conflicts across concurrent missions.

name: Track asset location
description: Show live position and status of every asset on a common map.

name: Register a new asset
description: Add a new asset with its configuration and capabilities to the inventory.

name: Schedule preventive maintenance
description: Plan recurring maintenance windows that minimize impact on tasking.

name: Report an asset fault
description: Log a fault from the field with photos and severity for triage.

name: Forecast asset availability
description: Predict which assets will be mission-ready over the next 30 days.

name: Manage spare parts
description: Track spare part stock levels and reorder points across sites.

name: Transfer asset custody
description: Hand an asset off between units with a documented custody chain.

name: View asset utilization
description: See usage hours and tasking load per asset to balance wear.

name: Retire an asset
description: Remove an asset from service and archive its full history.

name: Audit asset configuration
description: Compare an asset's reported configuration against its approved baseline.

name: Search historical data
description: Query archived mission and sensor data by time area and keyword.

name: Build a trend dashboard
description: Assemble charts of key metrics that update as new data arrives.

name: Export analysis products
description: Package analysis results into shareable briefing-ready formats.

name: Fuse multi-source data
description: Correlate reports from multiple sensors into a single track picture.

name: Annotate imagery
description: Mark up collected imagery with labels visible to other analysts.

name: Generate activity reports
description: Produce scheduled summary reports of operations for leadership.

name: Detect anomalies automatically
description: Flag unusual patterns in incoming data for analyst review.

name: Replay past operations

name: Measure plan vs actual
description: Quantify how executed missions deviated from their plans.

name: Tag data for training sets
description: Curate labeled datasets from operational data for model training.

name: Send tasking to field units
description: Deliver approved tasking to field devices with receipt confirmation.

name: Chat with field teams
description: Exchange secure messages with deployed teams from the operations floor.

name: Broadcast alerts
description: Push priority alerts to all affected units simultaneously.

name: Share a common operating picture
description: Give partner organizations a filtered live view of operations.

name: Sync over low bandwidth
description: Keep field devices usable and synchronized on degraded links.

name: Operate disconnected

name: Translate message formats
description: Convert between partner message standards automatically.

name: Manage distribution lists
description: Control which roles and units receive which message types.

name: Acknowledge received orders
description: Track which recipients have seen and acknowledged each order.

name: Escalate unanswered requests
description: Automatically escalate requests that miss response deadlines.

name: Log in with unit credentials
description: Authenticate using organization-issued credentials and tokens.

name: Manage user roles
description: Grant and revoke role-based permissions with an approval trail.

name: Audit user activity
description: Review a tamper-evident log of who did what and when.

name: Mark data classification
description: Label data with handling caveats that follow it everywhere.

name: Enforce need-to-know views
description: Filter every screen to what the current user is cleared to see.

name: Sanitize data for release
description: Strip sensitive fields from products before external sharing.

name: Recover a locked account
description: Restore access for a locked-out user through a verified process.

name: Rotate cryptographic keys
description: Update keys across the system without service interruption.

name: Detect intrusion attempts
description: Alert security staff to suspicious access patterns in real time.

name: Manage device enrollment
description: Approve and revoke field devices allowed to connect.

name: Train a new operator
description: Guide a new operator through core workflows with practice scenarios.

name: Certify operator proficiency
description: Record completion of required proficiency checks per role.

name: Practice in a sandbox
description: Provide a safe environment with realistic data for experimentation.

name: Update system software
description: Roll out software updates to servers and field devices in stages.

name: Monitor system health
description: Watch service status and resource use with alerting thresholds.

name: Back up and restore
description: Run scheduled backups and verified restores of critical data.

name: Manage reference data
description: Maintain shared lookup tables like unit codes and asset types.

name: File a support ticket
description: Report a system problem and track it to resolution.

name: Measure system usage
description: Report which features are used how often by which roles.
